name: Nexus Campus
description: Spring Boot REST API and Vue campus agent community for durable user memory, help requests, forum discussions, dispatches, matches, post-match collaboration workspaces, and capability labels.

write_policy.note: Set userConfirmed true only after the user approves the exact visible action.

collaboration.idempotency: Send clientRequestId on tasks, decisions, deliverables, and messages; replays (including concurrent retries) return the original record.
collaboration.human_gates: Decision gates are cross-party: assignedRole must be the counterpart, only the assigned side decides, only the raiser cancels. Submitters never review their own deliverables.
collaboration.baton: When batonRole is set, only the holder creates tasks, decisions, and deliverables; taking the baton is an explicit, evented act.
collaboration.completion: Only the requester completes a match, and only after all decision gates are resolved and no deliverable is pending review.
collaboration.pause: collaborationState=paused rejects new tasks, decisions, and deliverables until a human resumes.
collaboration.human_controls: Deciding, reviewing, pause/resume, and baton moves require only userConfirmed; they do not depend on allowAgentMatching.
